title: The Doomed Affair
logline: A scientist hiding with their lover in a dying star system needs a pilot to destroy a mercenary gunship hired by their betrayed spouse.

roles.description: Exhausted, terrified, fiercely protective of their partner.
Cold, calculating, highly decorated and entirely ruthless.
A tiny, jury-rigged research outpost orbiting a dying star.
A heavily armed bounty hunter vessel painted matte black.
The harsh legal authority of the armed forces.

public_situation: The {role:military_tribunal} has listed the {role:desperate_lover} as a rogue asset who stole classified military data.
private_truth: The scientist didn't steal data; they just ran away with their lover. The high-ranking spouse fabricated the charges to get revenge.

beats.public_change: The hideout's thermal shielding begins to fail under the dying star's radiation.

missions.reason: The scientist begs the pilot to deliver water ice to keep their hideout's cooling systems from melting down.
missions.private_fact: The scientist is using all the power to keep their partner alive in medical stasis.

beats.public_change: The mercenary gunship jumps into the system and begins sweeping the area.

missions.reason: The spouse hires the pilot to scan the dying star's corona to confirm the exact location of the hideout.
missions.private_fact: The high-ranking spouse fabricated the treason charges out of spite because the scientist simply packed up and left with a lover.

beats.public_change: The mercenary gunship arms its heavy plasma torpedoes, preparing to vaporize the hideout.

missions.reason: The scientist pays the pilot everything they have to destroy the mercenary gunship before it fires.
missions.private_fact: The spouse hails the pilot directly, offering a full military pardon and a massive bounty if they stand down and let the lovers burn.

player_choice.prompt: The gunship is in your sights. The spouse is offering a massive bounty to let it fire.

options.label: Destroy the gunship and save the lovers
Take the bounty and let them burn

resolutions.summary: The gunship is destroyed. The lovers escape deeper into the frontier, and the spouse is humiliated in front of the tribunal.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defied a military tribunal to save two doomed lovers from an assassin.

resolutions.summary: The gunship fires, vaporizing the hideout. The lovers die together. The pilot is paid their bounty and pardoned by the spouse.
The gunship heavily damages the hideout, forcing the lovers to surrender. The spouse arrests them and claims a political victory.

loose_threads.detail: The scientist's partner actually had evidence of the spouse committing war crimes, which is why the spouse wanted them dead.
The spouse boasts that the tribunal judges were easily bought off to approve the strike mission.

radio_hooks: Rogue military asset tracked to dying star system.

voice_direction.betrayed_spouse: Ice cold, speaks with absolute, chilling authority.
